ceu: ✦ The opposition between the Moon and Saturn at {H:1803410109000}

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between relationships and your image. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between romance and friendships. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between family and your career. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between money and intimacy. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between your image and relationships. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between your inner life and routine. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between friendships and romance. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between your career and family. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between intimacy and money. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.
